finding.claim: OS command injection in /ping: the unauthenticated `host` query parameter is concatenated into a shell command string passed to exec(), so shell metacharacters give remote command execution as the server user.
finding.sink: child_process.exec("ping -c 1 " + req.query.host) at tools.js:7, which runs via /bin/sh -c

trace.note: Route handler for GET /ping with no auth middleware
req.query.host concatenated unsanitized into the command string and passed to exec(), which spawns a shell
Command stdout is returned to the caller, so output is exfiltrated directly

finding.guards_checked: No input validation, allow-list, or escaping on host. No authentication or authorization middleware. No other middleware (app.use) in the file. exec is used rather than execFile, so the shell interprets metacharacters. req.query.host can also be an array or object, which concatenates to an unexpected string. Repro: /ping?host=127.0.0.1;id or /ping?host=$(cat /etc/passwd)

verdict.reason: tools.js:7 passes "ping -c 1 " + req.query.host to exec() (shell) in the unauthenticated GET /ping handler (tools.js:6) with no validation or middleware, and tools.js:11 returns stdout (only when ping succeeds, so injected output is sent on success, but blind execution works regardless).
